title: BuilderIO/agent-native: a full-stack framework for agent-first applications
friendlyTitle: Agent Native helps developers build complete agent apps
summary: Agent Native packages an agent runtime with chat, tools, skills, memory, jobs, observability and handoffs, while allowing developers to connect their preferred SQL backend.
friendlySummary: The framework includes common parts such as chat, tools, memory, scheduled jobs, monitoring and agent handoffs.
whyItMatters: It provides a reference architecture for applications where agents are a core product capability rather than a chat widget added later. Teams can use the integrated components to prototype while evaluating which abstractions fit their production stack.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can start an agent app without connecting every basic part from scratch, then replace pieces as the product grows.
